steps.label: Skript: 8 Objekt-/Raum-Shots ohne Menschen

steps.run: /Applications/Blender.app/Contents/MacOS/Blender -b -P hero2.py -- save > save.log 2>&1; grep -v -i -e bearer -e api_key save.log | grep -e HERO2 -e rror | tail -6; ls -la hero2.blend
steps.label: Blender baut 8 kleine Sets

steps.run: [ -f hero2.blend ] || exit 1; mkdir -p r; T=$(date +%s); set -- 400 499 500 574 600 674 700 787; while [ $# -gt 0 ]; do /Applications/Blender.app/Contents/MacOS/Blender -b hero2.blend -P hero2.py -- render $1 $2 >> render.log 2>&1; shift 2; done; grep FRAME render.log | awk '{s+=$3;n++} END {print n, "frames, avg s", s/n}'; ls r | wc -l; echo render_s $(( $(date +%s)-T ))
steps.label: Blender rendert 4 Shots, 338 Bilder (16 Samples, 1 Prozess, Szene je Shot neu geladen, 1k/2k Texturen)

steps.run: /Applications/Blender.app/Contents/MacOS/Blender -b hero2.blend -P hero2.py -- encode > enc.log 2>&1; grep -e ENC -e SHEET -e rror enc.log | tail -12; ls -la *.mp4 sheet.png
